top_signals.title: Yen Surge Will Drive Up Other Asian Currencies, Strategists Say
top_signals.summary: The rally in the yen is set to bolster a number of other Asian currencies based on their relatively high correlations, according to Citigroup Inc. and Barclays Bank Plc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: AstraZeneca Shares Fall on Deal Talks With Bristol Myers
top_signals.summary: AstraZeneca Plc has explored an acquisition of Bristol-Myers Squibb Co., according to people familiar with the matter, in a potential megadeal that would rank as the largest ever in pharma.

top_signals.title: Life after Orban: Hungary Inc. digs in as new political era takes hold
top_signals.summary: Former officials, companies and analysts said billionaires among former Prime Minister Viktor Orban's inner circle were rethinking operations under new leader ​Peter Magyar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
